providerBinding: provider is selected once at creation, included with proposalHash in termsHash, and is the only wallet authorized to accept
reviewPolicy: submitDelivery stores reviewDeadline = block.timestamp + 7 days; during that window the requester may request one revision per milestone with a nonzero reason hash and fixed seven-day resubmission deadline; after any submission, release is permissionless at the review boundary or immediate after buyer approval
milestonePolicy: createMilestoneBounty accepts 1-32 positive ordered allocations whose sum exactly equals funding. Every Unix deadline is mandatory and consecutive deadlines must be more than 21 days apart so one review, revision, and revised review cannot consume the next deadline. Only the active milestone can be submitted, revised once, approved, or released. Revised evidence must differ from the preserved original evidence commitment. Each release pays one allocation and advances the active index; the final release terminates the bounty.
bilateralSettlement: requester or provider proposes an exact provider payout in a funded, provider-accepted, delivered, or buyer-approved bounty; each offer lasts at most seven days and never crosses the active delivery or review deadline; the current proposer may cancel; only the counterparty can accept the unexpired exact amount; acceptance atomically pays the provider and refunds the remaining principal to the requester
